appropriate: the P's bowl becomes a head with an open wedge mouth and one small eye, so the letter itself is a little friend speaking a line aloud; fits Caregiver plus Jester without a caption
the P's bowl becomes a head with an open mouth and a dot eye: a letter reading aloud, which ties to the onliness of reading the line aloud and makes the name the character
distinctive: no bear, elephant, owl or blue tile like the five competitors, but the round bowl with a wedge mouth and dot eye echoes Pac-Man, so the silhouette is not fully ownable
no competitor among Epic, Ello, Khan Kids or Reading Eggs uses a letter-as-character, but the open wedge mouth on a round bowl is the Pac-Man silhouette
simple: a rounded stem, a bowl with a wedge cut and a dot: drawable in about four strokes, one dominant P silhouette
a rounded stem plus a notched bowl and a dot; redrawable in a few strokes, though stem and bowl compete slightly
legible: the P with its notch still reads at 16 and 24 px and in the browser tab; the eye dot drops out below 32 px; the Pip wordmark is clear in every lockup
the P and its mouth notch read down to 24 px and still read as P at 16 px; Pip wordmark reads at a glance in every lockup
adaptable: holds in black, reversed and the one-colour 64 and 32 panels; the dark app tile and avatar work; the open mouth gives an obvious motion logic (talking)
black, reversed, one colour 64 and 32, app tile, tab and avatar all hold; the mouth offers an obvious open-close motion
timeless: a mono-initial that doubles as the app icon is a 'use carefully' item and strategy.md gives the mascot reason, not the mono-initial one; otherwise flat with no trend shapes
no trend shape from the avoid list; a custom letter-character is durable
universal: the mirrored panel reads as a backwards P or a q; rotated 90 it becomes an odd chomping head on a bar; the Pac-Man echo is a secondary reading
mirrored reads as a q, rotated 90 reads as a Pac-Man on a bar; the Pac-Man reading is present in every upright panel
clear: unsearched: closest known look-alike is Pac-Man (games, not reading apps); no reading-app P-character I know of, though Pip School's toucan shares the name
unsearched: Pac-Man (Namco) is a famous registered mark with the same open-wedge-mouth round head; also letter-mascot P marks exist
congruent: round forms, one tilted element (the mouth) and no frame match; the stroke is heavy and chunky where the targets ask for medium and the name's light, small front-vowel sound; colour cannot be judged in black

round bowl and lowercase-friendly type fit, one note of play in the mouth; but the tall heavy stem and sharp wedge cut read heavier and harder than 'Pip' small and light, and the eye is small as required
system: horizontal lockup, app icon, favicon tab, nav bars, avatar and card all derive; no stacked lockup is shown and the eye is lost in the small tier
horizontal lockup, reversed, app icon, favicon tab, avatar and card all derive; P-as-icon doubles the wordmark's initial; no stacked lockup shown
